significance: A cave shrine about 200 m deep in Reasi district, some 80 km from Katra, whose rock formations are read as images of the gods around a self-formed lingam. Pilgrim numbers rose to roughly two million by 2016 after the Shiv Khori Shrine Board was set up in December 2003.
story: One passage inside the cave, now sealed, is said to have run through to the Amarnath cave in Kashmir.
